assertions.name: option_B_markov_amphicheirality_check
assertions.source: χ_(2,1)(β) = χ_(2,1)(β*) is the (only) non-trivial test for β ~_{H_3(q)} β*; (3) and (1^3) already agree by writhe argument.

description: Resolution probe for cor:knot-factor-amphicheiral.  Tests option B (Markov-amphicheirality: is χ_(2,1)(β*) = χ_(2,1)(β)?) and option D (Gram-pairing: spectral form via tr ρ(β·β*)) for the figure-eight braid β = σ_1 σ_2⁻¹ σ_1 σ_2⁻¹ ∈ B_3.  Uses explicit Hoefsmit (2,1) seminormal matrices.

option_B_markov_amphicheirality.interpretation: If markov_amphicheiral_at_q0 is true, 4_1 IS Markov-amphicheiral.  Corollary's framework survives via option B (sum-of-positive-squares formula a_K = Σ_λ w_λ · (χ_λ(β)/χ_λ(𝟏))²; no sign flip required).  If false, 4_1 is NOT Markov-amphicheiral and the corollary's 4_1 application is structurally wrong.

option_D_gram_pairing.interpretation: If 4_1 is Markov-amphicheiral (β* ~ β), then χ_(2,1)(β·β*) = χ_(2,1)(β²) by trace cyclicity of conjugation.  The Gram-pairing form gives a_K = Σ_λ w_λ · χ_λ(β·β*) / χ_λ(𝟏) — this is the right structural starting point per prop:knot-factor-spectral-derivation.
